title: Comparing, Ordering and Rounding
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through comparing, ordering and rounding.
definition: Compare whole numbers from the highest place down. To round to a given place, inspect the digit immediately to its right: 0–4 stays at the lower multiple, 5–9 goes to the next multiple. Replace lower digits with zero.

exercises.question: Round 36,482 to nearest hundred.
exercises.solution: 36,482 is 18 from 36,500 and 82 from 36,400; round to 36,500.

exercises.question: Round 85,000 to nearest ten-thousand.
exercises.solution: 85,000 is halfway between 80,000 and 90,000; round up to 90,000.

exercises.question: Round 99,950 to nearest hundred.
exercises.solution: 99,950 is halfway between 99,900 and 100,000; round up to 100,000.

summary: Compare whole numbers from the highest place down. To round to a given place, inspect the digit immediately to its right: 0–4 stays at the lower multiple, 5–9 goes to the next multiple. Replace lower digits with zero.
